name: Loose Fit Jeans
description: Loose-fit jeans crafted from raw cotton denim. Rigid feel during initial wear, softens over time. Straight leg from hip to ankle, neither tapers nor flares. Mid-rise. Rigid fabric. Five-pocket style, front zip fly and button closure. Model height: 187 cm.
source: Zara product page PRODUCT MEASUREMENTS, 2026-09-26, converted from inches (garment measured flat). Zara labels: 'Front tow hook' = front rise, 'Backfire' = back rise.
measurements_note: waist / hip = width measured flat (half circumference); total_length = waistband to hem (outseam); rise = front rise, crotch seam to top of waistband; back_rise = back rise. No inseam given: inseam is derived as total_length - rise.
